backend/main.mo: Main canister actor managing users, authorization, profiles, and ranking logic with sorting and profile update endpoints.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting old user data structures to new ones and generating rankingDetails for each user.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence metadata mapping features to affected frontend ranking files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of various frontend source files across state, UI, and domain logic.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark CSS variables and applying theme-driven global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint loading the React app root and main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling routing, login gating, theme initialization, and backend profile sync.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Utilities to export app state as JSON and import/migrate backups with validation.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Defines backup schema, creation, validation, and migration logic for app state.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Renders an animated circular progress indicator with color-coded percentage display.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Displays a subject’s attendance stats with progress, streaks, and trend indicators.
Provides the main app layout with header, footer, and spacing to avoid nav overlap.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Sheet UI for marking today's classes by selecting attendance status per scheduled slot.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Bottom navigation bar with five tabs and active-state transitions.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Shows app branding, version info, and founder details with theme-aware logo display.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: UI for exporting and importing backups with confirmation before restoring state.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages notification settings, permissions, and sending a test notification.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Interactive profile name editor with edit/save/cancel flow and validation.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: UI control for adjusting target attendance using a slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Settings component to choose theme mode and color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive subject-related actions.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing a subject with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: Error boundary that displays a fallback UI and allows reloading the app.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo during initial loading.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Displays non-blocking toast notifications for thrown errors.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Utility functions for computing attendance stats, insights, streaks, and target-related metrics.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer managing attendance state updates for subjects, events, timetable slots, exchanges, settings, and user gamification data.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Defines core attendance domain types, default settings, and initial app state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Provides premium insight utilities for predicting attendance trends and generating streak messages.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Utility functions for computing streak lengths and determining milestone awards.
Validates display names with trimming, length checks, and character rules.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity with automatic query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hooks for authentication, identity loading, and login state management.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles including light/dark themes, midnight variant, animations, and accessibility settings.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Branding constants and functions returning theme-aware logos and metadata.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: General utilities including class merging, ID generation, date helpers, and preset subject colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates formatted notification titles and bodies for class marking actions, including single and multi-status updates.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wraps the browser Notifications API with support checks, permission handling, and unified result reporting.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Renders the main dashboard, computes stats and streak milestones, and submits earned milestone points to the backend.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Provides a name-only login form with validation and creates a basic user profile on submit.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Displays user settings with profile editing, theme and preference controls, and backend profile syncing.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Shows overall attendance statistics with charts and breakdown cards for attended, missed, and cancelled classes.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Displays detailed per-subject stats, safe bunk and target calculations, and supports edit, reset, and delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Renders a weekly timetable grid with edit mode to assign subjects to time slots and updates state via SET_TIMETABLE_SLOT.
frontend/src/rank/ConfettiBurst.tsx: Displays a fixed confetti overlay by generating animated particles on mount.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Provides legacy wrapper functions for submitting points and fetching rankings using RankingService.
frontend/src/rank/RankBadge.tsx: Shows styled rank badges with special designs for ranks 1–3 and gradient numeric badges for others.
frontend/src/rank/rankCache.ts: Manages localStorage caching of ranking data with validation and safe error handling.
frontend/src/rank/RankingModel.ts: Defines ranking UI types and provides mapping and validation helpers for backend ranking entries.
frontend/src/rank/RankingRepository.ts: Fetches paginated or full ranking data from the backend and submits user points with proper rank numbering.
frontend/src/rank/RankingScreen.tsx: Displays the leaderboard with polling, auto‑scroll, Top‑3 effects, and user highlighting using RankingService.
frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Orchestrates ranking fetches, caching, pagination, and point submission via RankingRepository.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Loads actor, user info, and passes them to RankingScreen.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Creates a React Context store using a reducer, loads persisted state on mount, and saves state changes with debounce.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Handles saving/loading AppState via IndexedDB with validation and merging defaults for missing fields.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Provides low-level IndexedDB helpers to save, load, and clear the app state in a single object store.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies and initializes theme settings, toggling dark mode and setting theme variants based on user settings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters, syncing them to sessionStorage, and managing persisted query values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, animations, plugins, and dark mode behavior.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s high-level state, requirements, issues, and architectural notes for development planning.
